gloss: nuts and seeds; seed and fruit

definitions.gloss: nuts and seeds; seeds and fruits
definitions.explanation: A collective term for the edible seeds, nuts, and small dried fruits of plants. Used in food science, nutrition, and botany to refer to this food category as a group.

examples.japanese: {種実|しゅじつ}⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: Nuts and seeds are rich in nutrition.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{種実|しゅじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This dish uses plenty of nuts and seeds.

examples.japanese: ⟦アーモンド→アーモンド：10714_aamondo⟧やくるみ⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種実|しゅじつ}⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良質|りょうしつ}→良質：13949_ryoushitsu⟧な⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれて→含む：01982_fukumu⟧おり、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少量|しょうりょう}→少量：12436_shouryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{推奨|すいしょう}→推奨：12907_suishou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Nuts and seeds such as almonds and walnuts contain high-quality fats, and eating a small amount daily is recommended.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (seed) and ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (fruit/nut), used as a collective term for the broad category of edible seeds and nuts. Most commonly appears as {種実類|しゅじつるい} (the category of nuts and seeds) in nutrition and food science contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {種実|しゅじつ}⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧: nuts and seeds (as a food category)
- {種実|しゅじつ}⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧: nut/seed butter
- {種実|しゅじつ}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: nut/seed allergy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ナッツ→ナッツ：11253_nattsu⟧: nuts (loanword, commonly used in casual speech)
- ⟦{木|き}の{実|み}→木の実：13018_kinomi⟧: tree nuts; nuts from trees
- ⟦{種子|しゅし}→種子：17135_shushi⟧: seed (botanical term, more technical)

USAGE:
While ⟦ナッツ→ナッツ：11253_nattsu⟧ is more common in everyday conversation, {種実|しゅじつ}⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ is the standard term in nutritional guidelines, food labeling, and academic writing.
